T: It can't rain all the time. Breakfast helps.
D: A murdered musician returns from the dead a year later to avenge himself and his fiancée.
P: Serve the mains when Darla cooks Sarah a proper breakfast.
S: Devil's Night, the night before Halloween
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, black salt and a pinch of chilli flakes, served in dark bowls by candlelight.
Eric playing guitar on the rooftop in the rain
Thick white bread buttered on the outside, filled with cheddar and ham, grilled in a pan until golden and melting, cut into soldiers.
Cocktail franks simmered 5 minutes, tucked into small buns and topped with a quick beef chilli, yellow mustard and finely chopped onion.
M: Darla finally cooking breakfast for her daughter
Bacon fried crisp, eggs sunny side up, buttered toast and a little pile of hash browns on each plate.
Officer Albrecht, the cop who believes Eric
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and gravy.
W: Dark blackberries baked under an oat crumble, served hot with ice cream. Toss 750g blackberries with 80g sugar in a dish.
K: Strong black coffee, or a hot chocolate for Sarah.

s.note: Devil's Night, the night before Halloween
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn, shaking often. Toss with 50g melted butter, a good pinch of black salt and a small pinch of chilli flakes. Serve in dark bowls by candlelight, the room lit only by the flicker.

s.note: Eric playing guitar on the rooftop in the rain
s.how: Butter 8 slices of thick white bread on the outside. Fill 4 sandwiches with sliced cheddar and ham. Cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut each into long soldiers and serve hot.

m.note: Officer Albrecht, the cop who believes Eric
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar. Bake at 180C for an hour. Serve thick slices with buttery mash and gravy made from beef stock.

w.how: Toss 750g blackberries with 80g sugar in a dish. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour, 80g oats and 100g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Brew a pot of strong black coffee from freshly ground beans. For the hot chocolate, heat 500ml milk until steaming and whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate until smooth and frothy. Pour both into chunky mugs and listen to the rain on the roof.
